name: 98007 · Bellevue, WA
findings: ZIP 98007 (Bellevue) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98007 (Bellevue) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Education organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 education organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
